# ResQ Tyres & Recovery

Last updated: 10 October 2026.

> Mobile tyre fitting and puncture repair in Leeds, Wakefield and Harrogate, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We come to the
> vehicle at home, at work or at the roadside, with brand-new tyres on board. There is no shop or depot
> to visit; the service is mobile only.

**What we do.** Mobile tyre replacement, with new tyres brought to you and fitted on site. Puncture
repair where the tyre can be safely repaired: £70–£120, depending on distance and tyre
size. Emergency tyre call-out 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including bank holidays.
Planned tyre fitting at home or at work. On-site wheel balancing and valve replacement.
Locking wheel-nut removal, £25–£40 per nut. We carry the specialist tools. Jump starts for flat batteries, from £50, with no charge if the car still won't start.

**What we do not do.** No wheel alignment. No battery supply or fitting. No fitting at a garage, shop or depot: there are no
premises to visit. No vehicle recovery. The word "Recovery" is part of the trading name only. Bradford (BD), Huddersfield (HD) and Halifax (HX) are outside the coverage area.

**Coverage.** Only these confirmed postcode districts are covered: all Leeds districts from LS1 to LS29,
including LS24 (Tadcaster); HG1, HG2 and HG3 around Harrogate; WF1 to WF13 across Wakefield,
Castleford, Pontefract, Normanton, Featherstone, Hemsworth, Knottingley and Dewsbury; and in York
YO1 (city centre), YO10 (Fulford, Heslington) and YO24 (Acomb, Dringhouses), plus YO8 (Selby).
WF14 and above, and other YO districts, are outside the area. Places in the covered districts include Leeds,
Wakefield, Dewsbury, Pudsey, Morley, Castleford, Garforth, Pontefract, Harrogate, Tadcaster, York
and Selby. Outside those districts, call and ask. We may still be able to reach you.

**Hours.** 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including bank holidays.

**Prices and payment.** Tyre prices are per tyre and vary by size and brand: £40–£100 each for 14 to 17 inch wheels
and £80–£150 each for 18 to 20 inch wheels. One tyre fitted costs from £90 (tyre from £40 plus mobile fitting from £50).
Mobile fitting is charged on top, from £50 per tyre, depending on distance. There is no separate call-out fee. The exact price is confirmed by
phone before any work starts. 30% off the total price when you book a planned fitting for all four tyres, subject to
availability. No deposit and no online payment. You pay on completion, by card or cash.

**Contact.** Phone 07438 562633 (+44 7438 562633). WhatsApp https://wa.me/447438562633. Email
resqtyresrecovery@gmail.com. Base and registered office (mobile service, no customer visits): Unit 8A, 8 Lavender Walk, Leeds, LS9 8JB, United Kingdom.

**Reviews.** Rated 5.0 on Google from 233 reviews (checked October 2026).

**About.** Trading name ResQ Tyres & Recovery. Operating since 2023, based in Leeds. The company is RESQ TYRES & RECOVERY LTD, registered in England and Wales, company number 16702233, registered office Unit 8a Lavender Walk, Leeds LS9 8JB.
